clips.title: The story
paras: Foreman Silixiz carries the key to the Venture Company tower near the Sludge Fen. Shattered Hand operatives must take it from his pocket as part of an undercover sabotage assignment.

North of the Sludge Fen, the Venture Company keeps its tower under tight security. Grand Foreman Puzik Gallywix oversees the isolated lookout, while goblin mercenaries patrol the compound. Outside, Foreman Silixiz carries the tower key. A Shattered Hand operative from Orgrimmar must steal it and keep it. Force will not do: the operative must enter unseen and pick Silixiz's pocket, proving their stealth before climbing into the tower's toxic upper levels.
